John B. Goodenough was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society in 2010. The Royal Society's [profile page](https://royalsociety.org/people/11514/) lists him as ForMemRS, elected 2010, and a [University of Texas announcement](https://news.utexas.edu/?p=128794) dates his election to May 2010. The team note's phrasing about "the year the 2010s began" is loose, but it still points to 2010.

CONFIDENCE: 93
